classification_policy.at_risk: Observed delivery score < 75 OR observed quality score < 90, unless overall confidence is Low (Sparse Data). A No Data fallback does not trigger a guardrail.
classification_policy.policy_status: Fixed illustrative business rules; not tuned on the holdout labels.

notes: This is separate from data/ground_truth_evaluation.json, which evaluates the committed dataset generated with seed 20261022.
Both datasets are synthetic; the metrics demonstrate reproducibility against generated labels, not validated performance on real supplier data.
The holdout script generates its dataset in a temporary directory during CI. This committed summary records the successful CI run output.
